idea.title: A heart passing through a crescent
idea.premise: Two luminous curved objects rotate through a shared space without hiding each other. Motion: coral heart at 1 relative turns, electric_blue crescent at 1 relative turns.
idea.viewer_experience: Follow one colored object through the overlap; the near/far interpretation may change.

illusion.cue_withheld: Occlusion at crossing contours, depth-dependent brightness and perspective size cues
illusion.question: Can you keep the same object in front throughout the turn?
illusion.observable_event: The two silhouettes cross in projection, narrow into side views, then overlap again.

idea.authorship_note: Reference-inspired procedural concept; uniqueness is not externally verified.

reasons: Geometry, motion, palette and compositing are supported by relational_scene.Scene
